control_match: Original abs(log1p(mean_oe) difference) + abs(valid_fraction difference), rep1 only; deterministic window-index tie break
control_spatial_rules: Same source width; no author annotation in source crop; exclude the full 54-variant envelopes of all 21 candidates; one partition per envelope; controls mutually envelope-disjoint within each candidate set
control_qc: Original min_valid_fraction=0.8/max_zero_fraction=0.8 on natural pixels; rep1 full-grid QC before selection; finite and quality-qualified rep1/rep2 control correlations count toward the unchanged minimum ten
control_freeze: Freeze up to twenty control IDs per candidate before loading rep2; do not replace controls based on correlation or candidate outcome
replication_candidate_endpoint: Original-width, original-anchor, zero-shift, no-occlusion support; all 54 variants and all six anchor/scale cells reported as sensitivity, without a new support pass threshold
morphology_candidate_endpoint: Unchanged primary/supplement two-metric, two-replicate distances and per-scale >=0.8 robust rule; missing calibration remains NA

known_retrieval.class_retrieval: Held-out known query vs fixed role-0 references, same variant, exclude same ID and any overlapping full envelope; report both WT, class prior and hypergeometric top5 chance
known_retrieval.identity_retrieval: Known rep2 query vs rep1 gallery of fixed references plus known calibration queries; own ID is the positive, overlapping different IDs are excluded; diagnostic only
known_retrieval.coverage: Report every fixed query, every one of 54 variants, failures and absent classes; no query or variant selection by retrieval result

interpretation: User-requested development validation of frozen candidates on previously viewed WT. No training, no raw genome scan, no independent external confirmation; background support controls do not replace known-shape calibration.
